svg.title: Dwago: Journey to Hushfall, a game in development
svg.desc: Title screen for Yunus's game Dwago: Journey to Hushfall. A real in-game capture of a grassy hillside with a campfire and the red-cloaked hero sits in a chunky pixel frame. A pixel hand cursor steps flat colour tints over the capture through gold, rose, violet and night moods like a settings menu, a nod to his Echo Pool lighting post. The flame health bar flickers. Beside the screen a pixel hero rests at a campfire, hops onto the trailer button so it presses down, then walks back to the fire. The text reads: A cozy adventure: satisfying combat, boss fights and a world full of secrets. In development, separate from the dwago code tool. Press play to watch the trailer.
